chunks.title: Password reset
chunks.text:
Password reset
Use 'Forgot password' on the login screen. A reset link is emailed and expires after 1 hour. Check your spam folder if you don't see it.

chunks.title: Changing email
chunks.text:
Changing email
Email changes require verification. A confirmation link is sent to the new address, and a notice goes to the old one. The change is complete after you click the link.

chunks.title: Two-factor authentication
chunks.text:
Two-factor authentication
Enable 2FA in Settings > Security. If you lose your device, use a backup code. If you have none, contact support for identity verification.

chunks.title: Deleting your account
chunks.text:
Deleting your account
Go to Settings > Account > Delete account. Deletion is permanent after a 14-day grace period during which you can log in to cancel it.

chunks.title: Locked account
chunks.text:
Locked account
After 5 failed login attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes. Resetting your password unlocks it immediately.

chunks.title: Adding teammates
chunks.text:
Adding teammates
Go to Settings > Team > Invite member, enter their email, and choose a role. They receive an invitation link by email. Pending invitations can be resent or revoked from the same page.

chunks.title: Verification email not received
chunks.text:
Verification email not received
Check spam and promotions folders and confirm the email address is spelled correctly. In Settings > Account, choose Resend verification email. Links expire after 1 hour. If it still doesn't arrive, add our sender address to your safe list or contact support.

chunks.title: Changing your username
chunks.text:
Changing your username
Go to Settings > Profile > Username, enter the new name, and save. Usernames must be unique, and you can change yours once every 30 days.

chunks.title: Can't log in
chunks.text:
Can't log in
If you can't log in, use 'Forgot password' on the login screen. After 5 failed attempts the account locks for 15 minutes; resetting your password unlocks it immediately. If the reset email never arrives, check spam, confirm you used your account email, and request a new link (links expire after 1 hour). If it still doesn't arrive, contact support for identity verification.

chunks.title: Refunds
chunks.text:
Refunds
Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after approval. They return to the original payment method. To request one, go to Settings > Billing > Request refund, or contact support within 30 days of the charge.

chunks.title: Invoices
chunks.text:
Invoices
Invoices are available in Settings > Billing > Invoices. You can download each one as a PDF. To add a company name or tax ID, edit Billing details before the invoice is generated.

chunks.title: Duplicate or unexpected charges
chunks.text:
Duplicate or unexpected charges
If you see a duplicate charge, it is often a temporary authorization hold that drops off within 3-5 business days. If it remains after that, contact support with the date and amount and we will investigate.

chunks.title: Plans and billing cycle
chunks.text:
Plans and billing cycle
You can switch between monthly and annual billing in Settings > Billing > Plan. Upgrades take effect immediately with prorated charges. Downgrades take effect at the next renewal date.

chunks.title: Failed payments
chunks.text:
Failed payments
If a card is declined, check the card details and that the bank allows online payments. We retry failed payments automatically up to 3 times over 7 days. You can update your card in Settings > Billing > Payment method.

chunks.title: Price increases
chunks.text:
Price increases
Your price can go up if your plan changed, you added seats or add-ons, a promotional or trial discount ended, or taxes changed. Upgrades are charged prorated immediately. Check the line items in Settings > Billing > Invoices to see what changed. If the amount still looks wrong, contact support with the invoice date.

chunks.title: Contact and hours
chunks.text:
Contact and hours
Support is available by chat and email, Monday to Friday, 9am-6pm. Replies usually arrive within one business day.

chunks.title: Escalation
chunks.text:
Escalation
For urgent issues such as security concerns or suspected unauthorized access, mark the ticket as urgent and a human agent will respond as a priority.

chunks.title: App crashes or freezes
chunks.text:
App crashes or freezes
Clear the app cache, update to the latest version, and restart your device. If the crash continues, reinstall the app and send us the app version and device model.

chunks.title: Upload errors
chunks.text:
Upload errors
Files must be under 100 MB. Supported formats: PDF, PNG, JPG, CSV, DOCX. A 500 error on upload is usually temporary; retry after a few minutes and check the status page.

chunks.title: Notifications not working
chunks.text:
Notifications not working
Check that notifications are enabled in the device system settings and in the app under Settings > Notifications. Disable battery-saver mode for the app, then log out and back in.

chunks.title: Service status
chunks.text:
Service status
Live incidents and maintenance are listed at status.example.com. Subscribe there for updates.

chunks.title: Slow performance
chunks.text:
Slow performance
Check your internet connection, close other heavy apps, and update to the latest version. Try a different network to rule out connectivity issues.

chunks.title: API timeouts
chunks.text:
API timeouts
If the API returns timeouts, check status.example.com for live incidents first. Retry with exponential backoff, confirm your network and firewall allow outbound requests, and reduce request payload size. If timeouts continue, contact support with the endpoint, timestamps, and request IDs.

chunks.title: Export to CSV is empty
chunks.text:
Export to CSV is empty
An empty CSV usually means the active filters or date range return no rows. Clear filters, widen the date range, and export again. Also check that your browser allows downloads and try a different browser. If the file is still empty, contact support with the report name and filters used.

chunks.title: Page won't load in Safari
chunks.text:
Page won't load in Safari
Update Safari to the latest version, clear website data for our site (Safari > Settings > Privacy > Manage Website Data), disable content blockers and extensions, and reload. If it still fails, try a private window or another browser and send us your Safari version.

chunks.title: App problems and refunds
chunks.text:
App problems and refunds
If the app keeps crashing, follow the steps in "App crashes or freezes" first. If the problem continues and you want your money back, request a refund in Settings > Billing > Request refund, or contact support within 30 days of the charge. Include your app version and device model so we can also fix the crash.
